question: Can the exact complete 139-case desktop-team-ui-smoke.test.ts import and execute from repository source plus Node 24.22.1 alone, with no node_modules and no compiled artifacts?

answer.status: SOURCE-PROVED PREREQUISITE BLOCKER; NOT A RUNTIME RESULT
answer.reason: The top-level test import eagerly links desktop-backend-fixture.ts. Its non-type imports address literal packages/legacy-agent-host/dist/**/*.js files. Their source graph additionally requires compiled task-change-ledger exports and resolvable external/workspace packages. Node type stripping neither builds those paths nor installs/resolves missing packages.
answer.scope: This is sufficient to refute the Node-only setup. It is not a proof that an arbitrary partially installed setup is sufficient, nor an exhaustive every-transitive-package inventory.
